metadataRaw.title: Instant Sacroiliac Joint Pain Relief (BUTT WALK!)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the butt walk exercise, which may give sacroiliac joint (aka SI joint) pain relief within 30 seconds.

This exercise will focus on lengthening and, more importantly, strengthening the main muscles that help support the sacroiliac joint. That way we can get both quick and long-lasting pain relief.

Let us know how it works for you!
